title: Marketplace automation template
description: An automation template, data only: the envelope of the catalog around the automation package the hub exports (`automation-package`, version 1) and brings in as a proposal. The hub decides in the end; scripts/lib/template-rules.mjs holds what a schema cannot say, the rules of the definition the hub also refuses and what a public item never carries.

minAppVersion.description: Accepted and kept by the hub, never read. Leave it out.

min_app_version.description: Accepted and kept by the hub, never read. Leave it out.

manifest.description: The body of a connection type. A template carries `package` instead.

package.description: What `GET /api/automations/{id}/package` of the hub gives, cleaned for the public: the import reads `format`, `version`, `automation.definition` and `agents`.

id.description: The id of the item. The export writes the id of the automation in the hub that made it, which a public item does not carry.

agents.description: Copies of the agents the model steps name. The import offers each one the Organization lacks as a draft.

requirements.description: What the destination must have, as the export lists it. The import does not read it.

to_fill.description: The fields the export left out because they belong to whoever exported, for the person who installs to fill.

definition.description: The definition of the automation, as the hub saves it (`AutomationSpec`, which takes no unknown field).

voice_agent.description: Left for whoever installs to choose: blank or absent.

agent.description: An agent as the export writes it: what it says and how it works, never who made it or where it lives.
